name: dev host tmpfs — /tmp or /dev/shm above 80% of its size, per host and mount
description: Fires per host.name and mountpoint when MAX(system.filesystem.utilization) over 10 min for /tmp or /dev/shm on a dev host exceeds 0.80. Both are tmpfs (each 50% of RAM), so a filling /tmp IS memory being consumed: on 2026-11-13 /tmp reached 35-38G on vmi3006760 before Dolt was OOM-killed (15:32:41Z), unseen. Emitter: the hostmetrics/tmpfs receiver of the dev-host collector shape (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.yaml, include_virtual_filesystems), selected by livespec.host.role = dev-host, so a dev host joins by running that shape, not by a copy. Runbook: df -h /tmp /dev/shm; sudo du -xd1 /tmp | sort -h | tail -20; the leak owners are in livespec-dev-tooling plan dev-host-disk-retention (epic livespec-dev-tooling-qgwxo4). Owner: legacy-coordinator-agent routing, kubernetes-observability seat.
